ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Liquid Types
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
LIQUID_TYPES_MOD_1 (design/RimMandrake/RM_liquid_types_mod.md). Per-liquid TerrainDef suites cloned off vanilla water, plus one RM_LiquidProperties ModExtension the C# systems read for what native fields cannot say: pH/corrosion, damage-on-immersion vs contact, and (later) surface films.
SPIKE STAGE (LIQUID_TYPES_SPIKES_1, 2026-09-12): this ships ONE liquid (acid, shallow + deep) to prove the generator (Tools/generate_liquid_suite.py), the extension, and the corrosion MapComponent build and load. It is not the full §6 roster and has not been loaded in a running game — see infrastructure/state/items/LIQUID_TYPES_SPIKES_1.md for exactly what is proven and what is still owed to a live/quicktest pass.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign, planet or creature uses it. A liquid with an empty RM_LiquidProperties extension is still a complete, working TerrainDef — the mod degrades to "a generated water clone" with the C# absent.
